mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_conversation (conversation_id, user_id, title, status, creator, updater, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{creator}, #{updater}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, title, status, creator, updater, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM agent_conversation WHERE user_id = #{param1} AND conversation_id = #{param2} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, title, status, creator, updater, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM agent_conversation WHERE user_id = #{param1} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY update_time DESC LIMIT #{param2}, #{param3}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_conversation WHERE user_id = #{param1} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_conversation SET title = #{title}, status = #{status}, updater = #{updater}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND deleted = 0
